item.description:

Display name: Cloud Device Platform Collection Administrator
Description: Read and manage Cloud Device Platform collections, including profiles, applications, assignments, device specifications, snapshots, and profile snapshot SAS export for a partner business.

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 2f626d6a-86af-49fb-9414-13a48f86f2d8

Description: Read Cloud Device Platform data and query device metrics for partner businesses only, excluding snapshot SAS export. Does not grant sandbox access, ARM management, or role-assignment permissions.

Description: Read Cloud Device Platform devices and operation status, and start devices for a partner business. Intended for Scalar wake-on-connect.
Link: https://management.azure.com/1913c0ee-e341-4626-b2ee-ad4101335253?api-version=2022-04-01

item.description:
